questions.text: Ułóż pytanie z wyrazów: How often / you go / shopping?
accepted_answers: How often do you go shopping?
How often do you go shopping
questions.explanation: Pytanie w Present Simple tworzymy: How often + do + you + czasownik.

questions.text: Ułóż pytanie z wyrazów: How many times / you try / foreign food?
accepted_answers: How many times have you tried foreign food?
How many times have you tried foreign food
questions.explanation: Pytamy o doświadczenie: How many times have you tried ...?

questions.text: Ułóż pytanie z wyrazów: Who / you see / this morning?
accepted_answers: Who did you see this morning?
Who did you see this morning
questions.explanation: Dla zakończonego czasu używamy: Who did you see ...?

questions.text: Complete the suggestion: {{answer}} go to the beach?
questions.explanation: Shall we ...? to propozycja zrobienia czegoś razem.
Stałe wyrażenie to: That sounds great!
